spots.name: Pawnee National Grassland
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Blue Arena
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Earthlodge Rock
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,761 m (5,778 ft).

spots.name: Bidwell Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,486 m (4,876 ft).
